title: Goldfish holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='body' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb84d'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ff8c1a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e06a00'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='fin' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd27a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff9f2e'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='balloon' cx='35%' cy='30%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9ec4'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#ff5c9e'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d92e78'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- tail fin -->
  <path d='M22,52 C10,42 8,62 22,60 C14,68 12,50 22,52 Z' fill='#ff9f2e' stroke='#ffd27a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M24,54 C14,46 13,62 24,58 Z' fill='#ffc45c'/>

  <!-- top fin -->
  <path d='M42,36 C44,26 56,24 58,34 C52,32 46,34 42,36 Z' fill='#ffd27a' stroke='#e08620' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- bottom fin -->
  <path d='M44,60 C46,68 54,68 56,60 Z' fill='#ffd27a' stroke='#e08620' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='48' rx='26' ry='16' fill='url(#body)'/>

  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='53' rx='15' ry='7' fill='#ffdf9e' opacity='0.75'/>

  <!-- side fin -->
  <path d='M42,52 C36,58 44,62 48,56 Z' fill='#ffc45c' stroke='#e08620' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='44' r='5.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='63.5' cy='44' r='3.2' fill='#241a14'/>
  <circle cx='64.5' cy='42.5' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M69,52 C72,54 72,57 69,57' fill='none' stroke='#c45600' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M68,52 C72,40 66,30 58,20' fill='none' stroke='#f2e2b0' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='13' rx='11' ry='13' fill='url(#balloon)'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='8' rx='3.5' ry='4.5' fill='#ffd0e2' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M56,25 L53,29 L59,29 Z' fill='#d92e78'/>

  <!-- little rosy cheek -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='52' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ffb0a0' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
